interface.name: wana_shell_control_v1

description.summary: private compositor to shell control events

interface.description: A deliberately tiny Wana-owned protocol exposed only to the compositor's privileged shell connection. It carries desktop-shell actions that have no suitable public Wayland protocol.

event.name: toggle_launcher
event.description: Sent when the compositor consumes the configured global launcher shortcut. The shell opens the launcher if closed and closes it if open.
